parsed.rationale: All three records are unnamed extensions on `ProcessInfo.ThermalState` spread across three distinct packages (`DebugPanel`, `Wallpaper` throttling, and a Wallpaper sample-app HUD), and the cluster provides no field or method evidence (`fields_or_signature: []`, `jaccard: null`, `shared_field_count: null`) to confirm overlapping behaviour. The extensions almost certainly serve divergent domain purposes — debug metrics formatting in `DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift`, quality-signal throttling in `Wallpaper/Throttling/QualitySignal.swift`, and HUD display in `WallpaperSampleApp/DebugHUD.swift` — whose structural coincidence (all extending the same Foundation type) is incidental to their separate concerns. Consolidating them without body evidence risks coupling unrelated subsystems.
